title: The person's channel to DCLab, the DCLab panel, and the person's decisions relayed from the agent's ask (agents plan steps 1-2)
request: The owner (2026-10-26 night): make DCLab Code match every agentic system already built in R&D, using and adopting them (plan ~/.claude/plans/joyful-jingling-engelbart.md); $20 more budget.
spec: the agents plan, steps 1-2 (two channels: the agent's over MCP, the person's from DCLab Code's own page and asks)
plan: send the person's click to DCLab's HTTP API with DCLab's own page token, marked as DCLab Code's
a DCLab panel: projects, stages, held-back result, holdout reads, forbidden columns, waits
relay a decision the agent asks for through dclab_call when the person allows it on the ask card
keep the agent off the person's channel
tests, a live check, two reviews

decisions.decision: No new R&D route: DCLab Code uses DCLab's own page token from GET /api/config, as DCLab's page does
decisions.why: the owner: use what exists; the person's routes already check everything

decisions.decision: A decision the agent proposes is shown on the ordinary ask card with the whole request; on Allow it is sent as the person's click and the agent's own call never runs
decisions.why: one place the person decides, the same card as every other ask

decisions.decision: DCLab is told what each click is: dclab-code (the person's own), dclab-code:relay (the person allowed the agent's proposal), dclab-code:script (a test driver)
decisions.why: records that say a person decided must be honest about who proposed it

decisions.decision: Labels, consent, routing, accounts, settings, budgets and deletes are never relayed
decisions.why: they are the person's own judgments or switches, made on DCLab's own page

change: dclab-code: server/dclab_person.js (DclabHttp, PERSON_ACTS, overview), GET /api/dclab/overview and POST /api/dclab/act, RELAYED_DECISIONS/NEVER_RELAYED/relayOf and the relay in guards and engine, the DCLab tab, shell and fetch rules. R&D: chat_agents refuses /api/config and /api/auth/* and hides secrets in results; agentic/server.py marks the three surfaces.

findings.defect: the agent could read DCLab's page token through the bridge
findings.scenario: dclab_call GET /api/config returned csrf equal to the server's token
findings.fix: refused; secret-named values hidden in every result
findings.test: R&D tests/test_chat_agents.py (the token never in results; ScrubTests)

findings.defect: any local process could post the person's decisions to DCLab Code's relay
findings.scenario: curl GET / on 4317 gives the page token; POST /api/dclab/act recorded by person
findings.cause: the page token is in index.html
findings.fix: the relay needs the page's own Origin and same-origin fetch (a raised bar, no proof)

findings.defect: the team panel's buttons could never work for a question
findings.scenario: a question pause showed Approve ({approve:true}); DCLab answered 422
findings.fix: a question takes words (team_answer); an approval takes yes or no; the pause's own text and summary shown

findings.defect: every finished project invited a second holdout read
findings.scenario: after the final stage the holdout gate reads approved:false again
findings.fix: no holdout gate button once the holdout was read

findings.defect: a slow team resume was recorded as failed although it happened
findings.scenario: a 120 s abort while DCLab kept going
findings.fix: 600 s for slow steps; a timeout is sent, outcome unknown (ok null)

findings.defect: the person approved a body they could not see
findings.scenario: the card showed 300 characters; a long reason hid gate:holdout
findings.fix: the whole body on the card; a body longer than it shows is not relayed; agent-written notebook cells never relayed

findings.defect: run all was not marked as a holdout read
findings.scenario: POST /api/projects/p1/run asked as a plain decision
findings.cause: the holdout path list missed a bare /run

findings.defect: DCLab's record did not say the agent proposed a relayed step
findings.scenario: a relayed approval's reason went into project memory as the human's
findings.cause: the relay looked like a panel click
findings.fix: x-dclab-surface dclab-code:relay (or :script); the team's start is never relayed

findings.defect: an unknown outcome was recorded as success
findings.scenario: a relayed programme run passing 120 s: ok true and 'Done in DCLab'
findings.cause: the unknown case counted as no error
findings.fix: ok null, 'still working, follow GET /api/jobs'; 600 s for slow steps

findings.scenario: a relayed POST with query {start: final} ran from the start

findings.defect: the shell rule was easy to get around
findings.scenario: [::1]:8765, 127.1, a WebFetch to the token route passed
findings.fix: any call to DCLab's ports asks; a WebFetch rule; said to be a raised bar, not a wall

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
measurements.result: 97 of 97 (units 39, the panel and relay server tests, Chromium page tests)

measurements.name: R&D chat tests
measurements.gate: the token refused and scrubbed; the surfaces marked

measurements.name: live relay
measurements.gate: a decision the agent asks for reaches DCLab as the person's click after Allow
measurements.result: Haiku asked POST /api/projects/dc13527e853c/improve; Allow relayed it; DCLab queued the job; the visit was marked dclab-code; $0.003

measurements.name: browser pane check
measurements.gate: the DCLab tab shows a real project
measurements.result: 10 stages done, held-back roc_auc 0.805 (0.789 to 0.822), holdout read 1 time, duration kept out

outcome: The agent reaches DCLab's agents and asks for the person's decisions; the person decides on the same ask card or the DCLab panel, and DCLab records each act honestly.
lessons: When a person approves an agent's proposal, show them all of it, and tell the system who proposed it.
risks: any local program can read a local page's token: the guards raise the bar, they are no wall
